# `/auth-users` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /auth-users/v1/{id}

`getAuthUserV1` — Auth user details

Return the specified user's authentication system details.

- Scopes: sp:auth-user:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity ID
- Returns 200: authuser

### PATCH /auth-users/v1/{id}

`patchAuthUserV1` — Auth user update

Use a PATCH request to update an existing user in the authentication system. Use this endpoint to modify these fields: * `capabilities` A '400.1.1 Illegal update attempt' detail code indicates that you attempted to PATCH a field that is not allowed.

- Scopes: sp:auth-user:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Identity ID
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: authuser
